title: faux leaves strand
text: faux leaves strand. Purchased for a gluing type project, and they are the perfect size (very small leaves on a sort of vine).  There are way more feet than we will need (65 ft) but I'll figure out a different project to use the rest.  I pleasant medium green. Not sure why they call them eucalyptus leaves - they don't look anything like eucalyptus leaves, but ok. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
